content: On reception of DM13 command message via call of J1939Dcm_RxIndication with parameter Rx PduId set to the configured J1939DcmRxPduId and the hold signal set to ‘not available’ , the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall start timeout supervision and call BswM_J1939DcmBroadcastStatus with the updated broadcast status information ; see also [SWS_J1939Dcm_00055] , [SWS_J1939Dcm_00056] , [SWS_J1939Dcm_00057] , and [SWS_J1939Dcm_00058] .
